This plot is small, and I will not spend cash on fertilizer bags for it because that money is hard to find and beans on this mixed plot can still do with what I have at home. I will use the seed I kept and the manure I can carry, because I have seen that work before on small land like mine. I will spray a little when insects come, because if I leave cowpea like that, they can spoil it fast. I will farm it with rain and family hands, and I will not hire labor for this plot.
